_WARNING_TRUSTED_ISSUERS: TRUSTED ISSUER SET IS PART OF THE INTERFACE CONTRACT (decision 0011 §8.2a). A conformant verify() takes a REQUIRED trusted-issuer-set input with NO default and NO trust-everything path. This registry does NOT carry the trusted set — the harness derives it per-vector from each vector's `pinned_issuer` (the trusted issuer is the 0x11 key every vector pins, except the I2 control which pins 0x33). A real deployment supplies the trusted set at the call site, never from the record's self-declared issuer_key_id.
